Name: Stardew Speak
Author: Vall3121
Description:
[color=#efefef][size=6][b]StardewSpeak[/b][/size]
[size=3]Have you ever wished you could have a real conversation with the residents of Pelican Town? That you could ask Shane how his chickens are doing, or discuss the best gems with Abigail, and get a real answer? Now you can.[/size]

[size=3]StardewSpeak replaces the standard, repetitive dialogue with a powerful AI model that generates unique, in-character responses on the fly. NPCs will remember your previous conversations, react to your questions, and express themselves with dynamic emotional portraits, making every interaction feel fresh and meaningful.[/size]
[size=5]
[b]Core Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][i][b]Dynamic AI Dialogue[/b]:[/i] Say goodbye to canned responses. Type what you want to say, and get a unique reply every time.
[/size]
[*][size=3][i][b]Persistent Memory[/b]:[/i] Villagers remember your past conversations. Bring up something you talked about last week, and they'll know what you mean. Each save file has its own unique memory.[/size]
[*][size=3][i][b]Context-Aware[/b][/i]: Dialogue is shaped by the NPC's personality, your friendship level, the in-game location, time of day, and season.[/size]
[*][size=3][i][b]Emotional Portraits[/b][/i]: The AI analyzes the tone of its response and automatically sets the NPC's portrait to match their emotion—happy, sad, angry, blushing, and more.[/size]
[*][size=3][i][b]Seamless UI[/b][/i]: An input box appears automatically when you start a conversation. No clunky menus or hotkeys required to start chatting[/size]
[/list][/color]
[size=5][center]!! IMPORTANT: READ BEFORE INSTALLING !![/center][/size]
[size=3]This mod requires a personal OpenAI API key to function.

The AI model that generates dialogue is not free. Using this mod sends requests to OpenAI's servers, and this will cost you real money based on your usage.

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]You are responsible for all costs associated with your API key.[/size]
[*][size=3]Costs are typically very low for casual play, but they are not zero. A few hours of heavy conversation might cost a few cents.[/size]
[*][size=3]It is highly recommended that you set a hard spending limit in your OpenAI account dashboard to prevent any surprise bills.

[/size]
[/list][size=3]By downloading and using this mod, you acknowledge that you understand and accept the potential costs involved.[/size]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game once. This will generate a config.json file inside the StardewSpeak mod folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Open the config.json file with any text editor.[/size]
[*][size=3]Replace the placeholder text "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE" with your actual OpenAI API key.[/size]
[*][size=3]Save the file and launch the game.[/size]

[/list][size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size]
[size=3]Just talk to a villager! The dialogue box will appear at the top of the screen, and a text input box will appear at the bottom. Type your message and press Enter. That's it!

Press Escape to exit the conversation and close the text box.[/size]

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]This mod should be compatible with most other SMAPI mods.[/size]
[*][size=3] It is likely not compatible with mods that heavily overhaul the dialogue box UI.[/size]
[*][size=3]It is compatible with custom NPCs, but they will have a generic "friendly villager" personality unless they are specifically added to this mod's personality data.[/size]


[/list][size=5][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
[size=3]This is just the beginning! I hope to expand the mod with features like:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Giving the AI knowledge of major events (festivals, marriages).[/size]
[*][size=3]Allowing the AI to remember gifts you've given them.[/size]
[*][size=3]Adding more detailed personality profiles for a wider range of vanilla and custom NPCs.


[center]This mod was created by Vall3121. Please do not redistribute this mod without permission.
A huge thank you to the Stardew Valley and SMAPI development communities for making a mod like this possible.[/center]
[/size]
[/list]
